description: Cloud project management: Add or update a glossary entry. never_translate keeps the term as written in every language (no target needed). always_translate_as sets the required translation of the term for one locale; calling it again for another locale adds that locale to the same entry. An existing entry for the term (matched ignoring case) is updated, not duplicated. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

locale.description: Target locale of the translation, e.g. "fr" or "pt-BR" (always_translate_as only)

source.description: The term in the source language

name: babelize_glossary_set
title: Set Glossary Entry
